title: Preference Profile
description: Compact, per-user, trusted-derived signals recomputed periodically from active history. Contains DERIVED signals only, never raw prompt content. PRIVATE by default; never globally eligible without explicit consent.

source_count.description: Number of records the profile was computed from.

escape_hatch_frequency.description: How often the user chooses 'use your best judgment'.

signal_confidence.description: Per-slot confidence; a slot must reach >=0.7 with evidence>=3 to eliminate a clarifying question.

global_eligible.description: Derived user preferences are NEVER globally eligible by default. De-identification alone does not create consent.
